statistics.intervals: Pointwise percentile 95% and nominal Bonferroni 98.333333% for three AUC contrasts, approximate bootstrap coverage
statistics.resampling: One seed-row index matrix shared by all comparisons and metrics in a cohort
statistics.reporting: Report historical 1-5, extension 6-10 and pooled 1-10 separately, including all failed/zero-success runs
statistics.scope: Exploratory fixed-size extension authorized after seeing seeds 1-5; no optional stopping or superiority guarantee

failure_policy.next_method_on_failure: Stop after active method; retain failures and require an explicit audited restart plan
failure_policy.low_success: Not a failure; run the entire fixed budget without exclusion
failure_policy.non_finite: Fail rather than substituting loss, TD error or temperature values
failure_policy.power_interruption: No automatic resume; preserve partial attempts

caveats: This extends the post-AAAI automatic-temperature SAC cohort, not the legacy fixed-alpha prototype.
Keep the inherited original-goal observation components and separate HER-relabelled goal unchanged in all arms.
Retain native HGR inclusive-future pair convention and IS weighting; do not silently force it into the HER/PER future convention.
The existing HER/SABER source and HGR/PER source remain separate frozen snapshots.
Historical power-interrupted attempts are not pooled; only validated fresh complete runs are retained.
Runtime under five parallel seeds is descriptive, not a dedicated wall-clock comparison.
